svg.aria-label: Nineteen fresh-start attempts on a log scale. In attempts 1 to 10, while we were debugging, two became ready (19.3 s on a fresh image and 4.0 s) and eight hung or failed after 44 to 280 seconds. In the controlled run, attempts 11 to 19, seven became ready: six in 2.5 to 4.1 seconds and one in 65 seconds; two hung past 130 seconds.
